He is best known for Tarot-tories, his own system mapping the 22 Major Arcana and zodiac archetypes onto the geography of the United States.

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Quitting the System and Following a Calling", "body": "Luemas described deciding in 1999 that a job in the system was blocking his music, so he quit and lived off credit cards, which he said he did not recommend. He said a roommate on the Big Island claimed to have worked high up in the USDA and left him two books, which Luemas credited with starting his awakening. He said he began his podcast in 2013. Chance Garton said he had only recently left a full time job, helped by sound healing sessions and a Telegram community, and described the show as aimed at helping people leave the rat race."}, {"title": "The 2018 Hawaii Missile Alert Questions", "body": "Luemas said the 2018 false missile alert frightened the island for about 38 minutes and that he saw holes in the official explanation, including how the employee was presented on the news. He relayed a story that boaters on Maui heard an explosion at sea. One of the hosts first said the alert fell on January 18, but a quick search showed it was January 13, 2018. The same host described mapping tarot cards onto zodiac stations across the United States, with Hawaii as the Moon card, and suggested the event might have had a ritual meaning."}, {"title": "Hawaiian Kings, Language and Lost Civilizations", "body": "Luemas said he heard from his guest Brian Forrester that Hawaiian history may run backwards from the textbook version, and he said missionaries simplified the Hawaiian alphabet. He said the island of Niihau kept older letters. One of the hosts wondered whether underwater ruins and royal regalia pointed to a global civilization, and suggested the moon might be a map of an earlier world, while saying he was not asserting it. Luemas said King Kalakaua was a high degree Freemason and that Kamehameha's helmet resembled Spanish and Roman styles."}, {"title": "English as Slave Language or Magic Tool", "body": "One of the hosts read a comment from Snake calling English a slave language, and then argued that English carried deep roots from many cultures while its modern vocabulary was shrinking. Luemas said English seemed to be the language the powerful wanted everyone to speak. Another voice on the call said English entered the courts under the pet name language of the pleading. S.B. Alger said English was designed to be forced on conquered peoples but also with its makers in mind, so that those who understood magic could create and also bind."}, {"title": "Mana, Nature and Losing the Fear of Death", "body": "Luemas described mana as spiritual energy, said the veil felt thinner in Hawaii, and said people mailed back lava rocks because they believed Pele brought bad luck. Chance recalled a 2013 trip when nature seemed to speak to him and he never felt disconnected from it again. Davin Boerstler read a written account of a beach experience in which he said he felt that everything was alive and his fear of death vanished. S.B. argued that if everyone released that fear, the systems would fall apart. Later the group listened to mushroom music made by a PlantWave device that a listener shared on the call-in line."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Truth speaker, activist and hip hop lyricist Luemas joins Vibe Rant to talk about quitting the system and living free! As the host of Chant It Down Radio, Luemas has been bringing the heat to rekindle humanity's frequency of freedom, and help others find their way out of the rat race and into the Real World.
